'''Joseph Gaus''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 92 from Lansing, Mi. The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Gaus playtested the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001).
